UNIVERSALITY OF ANIMALCULAR LIFE. - LIVING ORGAN-
ISMS ARE UNIVERSALLY DITFUSED OVER EVERY PART OF THE GLOBE. THE
GENTLE ZEPHYR WAFFS FROM LOWER TO HOWER INVISIBLE, FRUETIFYING
ATOMS, WHICH QUICKEN BEAUTY AND FEGRANCE, GIVING THE PROMISE
OF A GOLDEN FRUITAGE, TO GLADDEN AND NOURISH A DEPENDENT
WORLD. NATURE'S OWN SWEET CUNNING INVESTS ALL INVING THINGS,

CONSTRAINING INTO HER SERVICE CHEMICAL ATINITIES, ARRANGING THE

"THE COURSE OF NATURE IS THE ATT OF GOD."
THE MICROSCOPE LEVELS THE FACT THAT MATTER MEASURING ONLY
T28006 OF AN INCH IN DIAMETER MAY BE ENDOWED WITH VITALITY,
AND THAT COUNTLESS NUMBERS OF ANIMALCULES OFTEN INHABIT A SINGLE
DROP OF STAGNANT WATER. THESE NONADS DO NOT VARY IN FORM,
WHETHER IN MOTION OR AT REST. THE LIFE OF ONE, EVEN, IS AN INEX-
PLICABLE MYSTERY TO THE PHILOSOPHER. EHRENBERG WRITES: " NOT
ONLY IN THE POLAR REGIONS IS THERE AN UNINTERRUPTED DEVELOPMENT
OF ACTIVE MICROSCOPIC LIFE, WHERE LARGET ANIMALS CANNOT EXIST,
BUT WE AND THAT THOSE MINUTE BEINGS COLLECTED IN THE ANTARCTIC
EXPERITION OF CAPTAIN JAMES ROSS EXHIBIT A REMARKABLE ABUN-
DANCE OF UNKNOWN, AND OFTEN MOST BEAUTIFUL FORMS."
EVEN THE INTERIOR OF ANIMAL BODIES IS INHABITED BY ANIMALCOLES.
THEY HAVE BEEN FOUND IN THE BLOOD OF THE FREG AND THE SALMON,
AND IN THE OPTIC FULL OF FISHES. ORGANIC BEINGS ARE FOUND IN THE
INTERIOR OF THE EARTH, INTO WHICH THE INDUSTRY OF THE MINER HAS
MADE EXTENSIVE EXCAVATIONS, SUNK DEEP SHAFTS, AND THUS REVEALED
THEIR FORMS; LIKEWISE, THE SAMALEST FOSSIL ORGANISMS FORM SUBTER-
RANEAN STATE MANY FATHOMS DEEP. NOT ONLY DO LAKES AND INLAND
SEAS ABOUND WITH LIFE, BUT ALSO, FROM UNKNOWN DEPTHS, IN VOL-
CANIC DISTRIETS, ARISE THERMAL SPINGS WHICH CONTAIN LIVING INSECTS.
WERE WE ENDOWED WITH A MICROSCOPIC EYE, WE MIGHT SEE MYRIADS
OF ETHEREAL YOYAGERS WAFTED BY ON EVERY BREEZE, AS WE NOW BE-
HOLD DRITING CLOUDS OF AQUEOUS VAPOR. WHILE THE CONTINENTS OF
EARTH FUNNISHES EVIDENCES OF THE UNIVERSALITY OF ORGANIC BEINGS,
RECENT OBSERVATIONS PROVE THAT "ANIMAL LIFE PREDOMINATES AMID
THE RETINAL NIGHT OF THE DEPTHS OF THE LIQUID OCEAN."
THE ORIGIN OF LIFE,
THE ANCIENTS, RUDE IN MANY OF THEIR IDEAS, REFERRED THE ORIGIN
OF LIFE TO DIVINE DETERMINATION. THE THOUGH WAS CRUDELY EX-
PRESSED, BUT WELL REPRESENTED, IN THE FOLLOWING VERSE:
"THEN GOD SMITES HIS HANDS TOGETHER.
AND STRIKES OUT A SOULD AS A SPARK,
INTO THE ORGANIZED GLORY OF THINGS,
FROM THE DEEPS OF THE DARK."

COMMON SENSE MEDICAL ADVISER.
ACCORDING TO A GREEK MYTH, PROMETHEUS FORMED A HUMAN IMAGE
FROM THE DUST OF THE GROUND, AND THEN, BY ARE STOLEN FROM HEAVEN,
ANIMATED IT WITH A LIVING SOUL. SPONTANEOUS GENERATION ONCE
HELL ITS SWAY, AND NOW THE IDEA OF NATURAL EVOLUTION IS POPULAR.
SOME BELIEVE THAT THE IMPENETTABLE MYSTERY OF LIFE IS EVOLVED
FROM THE ENDOWMENTS OF NATURE, AND BOULD THEIR IMPERFECT THEORY
ON OBSERVATIONS OF HER CONCRETE FORMS AND THEIR MANIFESTATIONS.
TO WHICH ALL OUR INVESTIGATIONS ARE RESTRICTED. BUT EVERY FUNE-
TION INDICATES PURPOSE, EVERY ORGANISM EVINCES INTELLIGENT DESIGN,
AND ALL PROCIAIM A DIVINE POWER. SOMETHING CANNOT COME OUT
OF NOTHING. WITH REASON AND PHILOSOPHY, CHANCE IS AN IMPOSSI-
BILLITY. WE, THEREFORE, ACCEPT THE DISPLAY OF WISDOM IN NATURE
AS INDICATIVE OF THE DESIGNS OF GOD. THUS " HAS HE WRITTEN HIS
CLAIMS FOR OUR PROFOUNDEST ADMIRATION AND HOMAGE ALL OVER EVERY
OBJECT THAT HE HAS MADE." IF YOU ASK: IS THERE ANY ADVANTAGE
IN CONSIDERING THE PHENOMENA OF NATURE AS THE RESULT OF DIVINE
VOLITION? WE ANSWER, THAT THIS BELIEF CORRESPONDS WITH THE
UNIVERSALLY ACKNOWLEDGET IDEAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY; FOR, WITH A
WISE AND EFFICIENT CAUSE, WE INFER THERE IS AN INTELIGENT CREATION.
AND THE DESIRE TO COMMUNICATE, GUIDE AND BLESS, IS ESPONded TO
BY MAN, WHO LOVE, OBEYS, AND ENJOYS. NOTHING IS GAINED BY
ATTRIBUTING TO MATURE VICEGERENT FORCES. IS IT NOT PREFERABLE TO
SAY THAT SHE RESPONDS TO INTERLIGENT, LOVING ONNIPOTENCE? OUR
FINITENESS IS Illustrated BY OUR INITIATION INTO ORGANIZED BEING.
EMERYING FROM A RAYLESS ATOM, TOO DIMINUTIVE FOR THE SIGHT, WE
GRAHALTY DEVELOP AND ADVANCE TO THE MATURITY OF THOSE CONSCIOUS
PONENTS, THE EXCREISE OF WHICH PURNIShes INDUSTABLE EVIDENCE OF
OUR IMMORTALITY. WE ARE PERVATED WITH INVISIBLE INFUENCES.
WHICH, LIKE THE NEEDLE OF THE COMPASS ITEMBLING ON ITS PIVOT,
POINT US TO IMMORTALITY AS OUR UTIMATE GOAL, WHERE IN THE SUNNY
ELIME OF LOVE, EVEN IN A SPIRITUAL REALM OF JOY AND HAPPINESS, WE
MAY RETURNAILY REIGN WITH HIM WHO IS ALL IN ALL.

WHICH IS RECEIVED INTO THE ACCTABLUM, THUS AMORDING A GOOD
ILLUSTRATION OF A BALL AND SOCKET JOINT. THE PATELLA, OR KNEE-PAN,
IS THE MOST COMPLICATED ARTICULATION OF THE BODY. IT IS OF A ROUND
FORM, CONNECTS WITH THE TIBIA BY MEANS OF A STRONG IGAMENT, AND
SERVES TO PROTECT THE FRONT OF THE JOINT, AND TO INCREASE THE
LEVERAGE OF THE MUSTES ATTACHED TO IT, BY CANSING THEM TO ACT AT
A GREATER ANGLE. THE TILIA, OR SHIN BONE, IS ENLARGED AT EACH
EXTREMITY AND ARTICULATES WITH THE FEMUR ABOVE AND THE ASTRAGALUS,
THE UPPER BONE OF THE TANSAS, BELOW. THE FIBULA, THE SAMALL BONE
OF THE LEG, IS SITUATED ON THE OUTER SIDE OF THE TIBIA, AND IS ARMLY
BOUND TO IT AT EACH EXTREMITY. THE TARSUS, OR INSTEOR, IS COM-
POSED OF SEVEN BONES, AND CORRESPONDS TO THE CARPUS OF THE UPPER
EXTREMITIES. THE METATARSUS, THE MIDDLE OF THE FOOT, BEARS A
CLOSE RESEMBLANCE TO THE METACAPPUS, AND CONSISTS OF FIVE BONES
SITUATED BETWEEN THE TANSUS AND THE PHALANGES. THE TARSL AND
THE METATAR SAL BONES ARE SO UNITED AS TO GIVE AN AREHED APPEAR-
ANCE TO THE FOOT, THIS IMPORTING ELASTICITY. THE PHALANGES, THE
TOES, CONSIST OF FOURTEEN BONES, ARRANGED IN A MANNER SIMILAR TO
THAT OF THE FINGERS.

THROUGH ITS SEVERAL STAGES, THAN IN CONSIDERING OTHER PATTS OF THE
HUMAN SYSTEM. THE FORMATION OF THE HAVERSIAN CANALS FOR THE
